score_description: Trained per-move detector (thesis arm A3g, seed 0): game-level output in [0, 1] per side. Not the computed attention-weighted score S_att, whose cutoffs live in suspicion_cutoffs_s_att.json.
source_description: Stratified sample of held-out TEST-partition games from the thesis corpus (analysis/heldout_test_eval/attn_tuned__best.csv on the HPC checkout; seed 20260915; up to 700 games each for bullet, blitz and rapid, every available classical and ultrabullet game; months with unpacked game files only; at least 20 plies). 2822 games (5644 sides) scored on CPU with the prototype's own src/detector.py and the frozen rating checkpoint, each side as the suspect against its PGN-header rating. The rating model never trained on these games, and the detector trained only on synthetic games.
note: These cutoffs describe how the detector score is distributed across ordinary, finished, rated human games in the held-out test set. They are not a cheat-detection threshold: the detector reached ROC-AUC about 0.75 on synthetic games from rating bands withheld from training, but only about 0.58 and 0.61 when 2 and 5 percent of moves were engine moves.
